description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cavalier of Gales, adding one mana of any color.
Cavalier of Gales and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Cavalier of Gales trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Cavalier of Gales, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Cavalier of Gales enters the battlefield, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand on top of your library.
Repeat.
